description: This file defines the class NullFeatures, which implements the Features interface with a singleton pattern representing a feature set that is always empty or null. It provides methods to manipulate features, but since it models a null or empty feature set, most methods return new instances or self, and it does not hold actual features.

classes.name: NullFeatures
classes.description: An immutable class representing a features collection with null or empty state. Implements methods for feature management by always returning empty or new instances, suitable for representing absence of features.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of NullFeatures representing an empty feature set.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating the feature does not exist.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance containing the provided feature.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Returns the same NullFeatures instance, as there are no features to remove.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with a feature definition set, but product does not hold actual data.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Returns the same NullFeatures instance; no definitions to remove.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with properties set, no actual data stored.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with a property set, no actual storage.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this represents a null or empty features set.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the feature set is empty.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of features.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON null object representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code based on the class name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns class name followed by empty brackets.
